_note: Russian A100 production profile with natural question/comma/period intonation: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base + run3 Russian stress LoRA (policy 'all', per-sentence splitting) for Russian dialogue, and pure base Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base (sky) for English translation narration.

ttsRu._note: Target-language (ru) engine: base Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base (lora=false, stress='onflag', turnMaxChars=0) so Russian questions ('?'), commas (','), exclamations ('!'), and periods ('.') get genuine native prosody without word-LoRA EOS clipping or pronunciation artifacts, while homograph stresses are verified and retaken by stressCheck: Russian goes to the model without stress marks, and only a word that stressCheck flags (or whose word is not heard in the Whisper transcript) is retaken with a mark on just that word.

lora._note: Base Qwen switch for non-ttsRu lanes (English sky narrator). Kept false so sky stays pure un-LoRA'd British English.

stressRetry._note: A stress-flagged sentence is re-synthesised locally with different seeds/temperatures; the take with the best stress match is kept.

clips._note: Audio for the lexicon's written examples (clips.py).

forms._note: Audio for the forms in the lexicon's tables (forms.py).

gpu._note: VRAM reservations for render/gpurun (budget GPURUN_BUDGET_MIB, default 38500 for an A100 40 GB).
